chat.welcomeMessage: Ask me to do anything with your {{host}} {{noun}}. I'll write and run office.js code to make it happen.
chat.exampleWord: Try: "Make all headings blue" or "Insert a 3-column table"
chat.exampleExcel: Try: "Put 1 through 10 in column A" or "Make a chart from B2:D8"
chat.examplePowerpoint: Try: "Add a slide titled 'Q3 plan' with three bullets" or "Make all slide titles bold"

quickActions.wordSummarizePrompt: Read the currently selected text (or the entire document if nothing is selected) and provide a concise summary of the key points.
quickActions.wordFormalizePrompt: Rewrite the currently selected text in a professional, formal administrative tone and replace the selection directly in the document.
quickActions.wordProofreadPrompt: Check and automatically fix any spelling, punctuation, grammar, and spacing errors in the selected text (or the entire document if nothing is selected), then list the corrections made.
quickActions.wordFormatStandardPrompt: Standardize the document formatting professionally: set body paragraphs to Times New Roman 13pt, 1.3 line spacing, justified alignment, and style all headings clearly.
quickActions.wordTableTocPrompt: Analyze the headings in the document, apply proper Heading styles, and insert a summary table of contents at the beginning of the document.
quickActions.wordTranslatePrompt: Translate the currently selected text (into Vietnamese if it is in English, or into English if it is in Vietnamese) while preserving its formatting in the document.
quickActions.excelAnalyzePrompt: Inspect the active worksheet's used range and summarize the structure, key metrics, and totals.
quickActions.excelFormatTablePrompt: Format the currently selected range (or the main data range on the active sheet) as a clean table with styled headers and auto-fitted columns.
quickActions.excelChartPrompt: Analyze the data in the current worksheet and create an appropriate chart to visualize the key trends.
quickActions.pptAddSlidePrompt: Read the existing slides in the presentation and add a new executive summary slide with key bullet points.
quickActions.pptFormatTitlesPrompt: Make all slide titles consistent and bold across the presentation.
